hero.title: The educational AI that guides your learning journey
hero.sub: LAURA is your tailormade personal tutor. Targeted revisions, exams prepared with precision, and clear explanations anytime.

audiences.title: Who is LAURA for?
audiences.sub: A tool designed for every stage of your academic path.

student.title: For Students (Secondary)
student.desc: Prepare for GCE O-Level, GCE A-Level, or regional exams. Simplified explanations, revision sheets, and solved past papers.

college.title: For College Students (Higher Ed)
college.desc: Deep academic guidance for university tracks, midterm revisions, exams, and thesis preparations.

features.title: Power-packed Features
features.sub: Everything you need to succeed, all in one place.

chat.title: Contextual Chat
chat.desc: Interactive conversation adapted to your level, capable of generating custom quizzes on the fly.

goals.title: Goals & Analytics
goals.desc: Set your targets and monitor your progress in real time with clear dashboards.

exams.title: Exam Simulator
exams.desc: Practice under real conditions on a massive database of Cameroonian and African past exams.

resources.title: Smart Resources
resources.desc: The system only suggests documents corresponding to your stream and knowledge gaps.

pwa.title: Take LAURA everywhere with you
pwa.desc: Scan the QR code with your smartphone to open the app on mobile. Thanks to our optimized PWA format, install it directly on your home screen without going through the App Store.

teacher.title: Are you a teacher?
teacher.sub: Join the LAURA community. Share your expertise, publish resources, and help thousands of students succeed.
